units.source_text: 听说名人依然留在伊东，体重也增加了一公斤多，计有四十一公斤了。

en.t: I heard that the Master was still staying in Ito, and that his weight had increased by more than a kilogram, bringing him to forty-one kilograms in all.

units.source_text: 还听说他携带了二十盒棋到疗养所去慰问伤病员。

en.t: I also heard that he took twenty boxes of go stones to the sanatorium to visit and comfort the wounded and sick soldiers.

units.source_text: 昭和十三年底，温泉旅馆开始用作伤兵疗养所。

en.t: At the end of Showa 13, the hot spring inn began to be used as a sanatorium for wounded soldiers.
